entries.label: SPARQL namespace prefixes
entries.text:
NAMESPACE PREFIXES:
  proto: <https://proto.atlas/ontology/>
  data:  <https://proto.atlas/data/>
  tax:   <https://proto.atlas/taxonomy/>
  rel:   <https://proto.atlas/relationship/>
  skos:  <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

SPARQL NOTES:
  - Instances live under data:{key}
  - Filter by class: ?x a proto:ClassName
  - Taxonomy-valued properties store URIs, not strings. To compare
    against a label, join through skos:prefLabel:
      ?x proto:someProp ?v . ?v skos:prefLabel ?label
  - Use OPTIONAL for anything not marked REQUIRED
  - Only use classes, properties and relationship types that appear
    in this context. If the question needs something absent from it,
    the graph does not model it — do not invent a predicate.

GENERAL PATTERNS (substitute real names from the context below):
  # Count instances of a class:
  SELECT (COUNT(?x) AS ?count) WHERE { ?x a proto:ClassName }

  # List with optional fields:
  SELECT ?name ?extra WHERE {
    ?x a proto:ClassName ; proto:name ?name .
    OPTIONAL { ?x proto:extra ?extra }
  } ORDER BY ?name

  # Traverse an edge (only with a declared relationship type):
  SELECT ?fromName ?toName WHERE {
    ?from rel:PREDICATE ?to .
    ?from proto:name ?fromName .
    ?to   proto:name ?toName .
  }

  # Group and count:
  SELECT ?key (COUNT(?x) AS ?count) WHERE {
    ?x a proto:ClassName ; proto:someProp ?key .
  } GROUP BY ?key ORDER BY DESC(?count)

  # Instances lacking an edge:
  SELECT ?name WHERE {
    ?x a proto:ClassName ; proto:name ?name .
    FILTER(NOT EXISTS { ?x rel:PREDICATE ?any })
  }

GRAPHDB RESTRICTIONS:
  - NEVER use FILTER(?x NOT IN (SELECT ...)) — use FILTER(NOT EXISTS {...})
  - GROUP BY requires every SELECT var to be aggregated or grouped
  - Subqueries must be wrapped: { SELECT ... } inside WHERE
  - Reasoning is enabled: transitive properties return inferred
    triples alongside asserted ones

entries.label: Codebase
entries.text:
CLASS proto:Codebase (Codebase)
  Definition: A source repository. One per ingested project.
  Properties:
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:name : string

entries.label: SourceFile
entries.text:
CLASS proto:SourceFile (SourceFile)
  Definition: One source file within a codebase.
  Properties:
  - proto:analysis : string
  - proto:description : string
  - proto:language : string
  - proto:name : string
  - proto:partOf : string
  - proto:path : string

entries.label: edge relationship types
entries.text:
RELATIONSHIP TYPES (edge predicates):
  rel:DEPENDS_ON — Source file imports or requires another source file in the same codebase.  [SourceFile -> SourceFile]

These are the ONLY edge predicates that exist in this graph.
Never invent others. Usage: ?from rel:PREDICATE ?to .
